dependencies.lockfile: none existed at baseline (no requirements file in repo)

description: Dixon-Coles bivariate Poisson ratings with time decay, ridge to a promoted-team prior, rho by grid search, and a geometric goals/xG blend; 1X2 picks flagged when model minus best-book de-vigged probability exceeds 2pp and Kelly > 0.

documented_performance.source: model/README.md at baseline commit (not independently reproduced at freeze)

hyperparameters.asof_granularity: UTC calendar date; matches with date < asof

known_evaluation_limitations: estimate_promoted_prior() uses every season in the data (incl. later ones) and is reused for all historical predictions
backtest.baselines() trains on all non-test seasons, including later ones
xi/reg tuned on 2024-2025 and alpha on 2025, then 2023-2025 reported as out-of-sample
team index includes future-season entrants (affects centring of ratings)
promoted flag uses max(season of training data), so at each season opener last season's promoted sides keep the promoted prior
xG treated as available the day after each match; actually ingested 2026-08-22, with no provider timestamps
football-data 'open' columns are early snapshots (Fri/Tue collection), not true opening prices
settle.report_clv averages over all three 1X2 outcomes, which cancels to zero by construction
settle.report_shopping counts every 3-hourly observation of a fixture as a separate bet
predict.py de-vigs each side using the book that offers the best price on that side (biases edge upward)

production_entrypoints.effect: polls odds, refreshes 2026 schedules, runs predict.py (non-preview): writes odds_logger/paper.sqlite3 and sends Telegram alerts
writes rosters/, active_rosters.json; may send Telegram

football-data.co.uk.use: historical Pinnacle/avg/max early and closing 1X2 odds

fotmob.use: rosters (fetch_rosters.py); not used by the model

status: UNVALIDATED -- preserved for comparison and regression only

test_results.note: settle.py reads the BallDontLie key at import time, so even --selftest needs credentials present
